summary: Regression fix verified. Floating Order Now CTA no longer overlaps the sticky navbar at any tested scroll position on desktop (1440x900), and mobile CTA behavior is correct on 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: Minimum measured gap at y=0 is ~11px, slightly under the requested 12-24px lower bound but this is due to the -4px floating animation offset (base gap ~15-16px, animation dips to ~11px). No overlap occurs. If strict >=12px is required, consider slightly increasing top offset or reducing the -4px animation amplitude.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 reported -28px overlap at scrollY=0 desktop with announcement bar visible. Fix applied via multi-tick updates, ResizeObserver on body, MutationObserver, and window load listener. Verified: min gap at y=0 = 11px (positive, no overlap). All scroll positions pass. Z-index hierarchy correct (navbar 1000, CTA 900). Mobile shows only bottom CTA at bottom of viewport. Both CTAs route to /order.
rca of the issue: Prior overlap was due to ResizeObserver being attached only to navbar; the announcement bar's async render pushed the navbar down without triggering the observer. Fix (multi-tick updates 50/200/600/1200ms, body ResizeObserver, MutationObserver, window load) now catches all layout shifts and recomputes navbar height correctly.
